paper_title: TL;DR Too Long, Do Re-weighting for Effcient LLM Reasoning Compression
caption: Comparison of accuracy and generation length between Vanilla CoT and our method on four benchmark datasets (GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, AMC) using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models. consistently reduces generation length while maintaining or improving accuracy across both 7B and 14B model scales.

model_annotations.German: This bar chart illustrates the generation length in words for two methods, Vanilla CoT and TLDR (ours), across four benchmark datasets: GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC, using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models. The horizontal axis displays the dataset names in the order GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC. The vertical axis, labeled “Generation Length (words)”, represents values on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8000, with tick labels at 1000-word intervals. For each dataset, two bars are displayed side-by-side: a light red bar representing “Vanilla CoT” and a dark red bar representing “TLDR (Ours)”. For GSM8K, the Vanilla CoT bar has a length corresponding to a value of 679 words, while the TLDR bar’s length corresponds to a value of 2951 words. MATH500 shows Vanilla CoT at 2951 words and TLDR at 4584 words.  AIME shows Vanilla CoT at 4584 words and TLDR at 6701 words. AMC shows Vanilla CoT at approximately 6701 words and TLDR at a value near 0. Percentage changes are indicated above the TLDR bars, specifically -31% for MATH500, -16% for AIME, and -65% for GSM8K. The bars are arranged in the order of the datasets listed on the horizontal axis, and the datasets are not visually emphasized.
